outcome: Hofbauer cell (HBC) density and morphology (size, circularity)
Placental lipid transporter gene expression (FATP4, FATP6, FABPPM, AMPKB1, AMPKG)
cohort: The study included 34 full-term pregnancies (N=15 with maternal BMI >=30 kg/m^2, N=19 with maternal BMI <30 kg/m^2) undergoing cesarean delivery.
finding: Maternal obesity is associated with sex-specific increases in Hofbauer cell density and altered placental lipid transporter expression, which correlates with umbilical cord blood triglyceride levels, with male placentas and cord blood being most affected.
cross-section timing: At birth (from term placentas and cord blood)
